findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 3 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 83 questions numbered 1-83; by section: 3.1 3, 3.1.1 2, 3.1.2 3, 3.13 3, 3.1.4 6, 3.2 3, u-dipole-moment-and-polarity-of-molecules 6, 3.3.2 15, 3.3.3 3, 3.4 2, 3.4.1 5, 3.5 2, 3.5.1 5, 3.6 5, 3.6.1 6, 3.7 1, 3.9 9, 3.10 4.

The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
